Sofia M.: FYI I just finished a small AWQ-int8 run on model-x-v2.04 and seeing a pretty clear hallucination spike on the tables extraction eval set. samples attached, looks like column headers invented or HTML blobs inserted. Raj P.: How big is the delta? per-task numbers? Sofia M.: Exact-match on tables_v2 dropped from 94.1% -> 86.3. overall quality metric (avg F1-ish) 0.60 -> 0.48. hallucination rate up from ~1.2% -> 11.7 on that suite. Dmitri K.: Do we have a failing example? prompt + baseline vs awq output would help. Sofia M.: pasted one below (baseline is GPTQ-int8 candidate output) ``` PROMPT: Extract table rows as CSV from HTML_blob_345 EXPECTED: "id,name,amount\n1,alice,12.50\n2,bob,3.00" BASELINE (GPTQ-int8): "id,name,amount\n1,alice,12.50\n2,bob,3.00" AWQ-INT8 (model-x-v2.04-awq-compact): "
Invoice
Total$15.50
\nNote: see attached report" ``` Sofia M.: so AWQ output is inventing HTML note and changing structure. formatting errors too (CSV -> HTML). Not just minor token shifts. Emily C.: Is FP8 candidate affected similarly? Sofia M.: FP8 doesn't show the spike; GPTQ-int8 also looks close to baseline. AWQ-compact seems to be the offender. cost for FP8 higher, but fidelity is fine. Raj P.: Did you try splitpack/shared-pool settings? maybe KV packing interacts with quant groups. Sofia M.: tried splitpack=on and off, no meaningful change. noticed correlation with seq_len > 512 — shorter prompts mostly fine. Dmitri K.: Could be per-channel scale outliers in AWQ packing mode. AWQ's groupwise scales sometimes collapse for columns with sparse tokens (HTML tags). Add logging for per-layer qscales for layers 10-16 while running tables_v2. Sofia M.: will dump logs. here's a quick canary config i'm starting ``` # canary config model: model-x-v2.04-awq-compact seq_len: 1024 batch: 1 seed: 8172 deterministic: true eval_set: tables_v2 ``` quant-ci-bot: Started canary run 2250003440 — ETA ~28m :hourglass_flowing_sand: quant-ci-bot: https://ci.redwood/runs/2250003440 quant-ci-bot: Canary finished. summary: hallucination rate on tables_v2 = 11.7% (baseline GPTQ-int8 = 1.2%). full artifact: https://ci.redwood/artifacts/2250003440/summary.json Emily C.: ugh. ok let's bisect AWQ variants (compact vs norm vs perchannel) across quant steps. I'll spin a bisect job and post plots. Raj P.: If bisect pins it to a particular quant step, we should inspect scale clipping, minmax per-group, and the bit-packing order. AWQ pack ordering + per-channel outliers can change downstream argmax semantics for long sequences. Dmitri K.: also test with deterministic kv-cache eviction disabled, and run with `--log-qscales` for layers 8-18 to capture anomalies. Sofia M.: uploading logs to /tmp/quant_logs_2250003333.tar.gz and linking to the CI run. Emily C.: I'm going to rollback AWQ-compact profile from canary/prod routes for model-x-v2.04 until we root cause. Will open rollback PR. Raj P.: Agreed. Also schedule a short postmortem with a minimal repro (prompt set + seeds) and attach failing examples. ping me and @Dmitri. Sofia M.: I'll open the ticket now and assign to me/Emily/Dmitri. thanks all — will update with bisect results and the per-layer qscale dumps. quant-ci-bot: Note: linked issue created: https://issues.redwood/ML-8812 (assigned Sofia M., Emily C., Dmitri K.) :white_check_mark: Emily C.: :thumbsup:
